title: Men's Sasquatch – Camera Shy Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the guy who hides his face the second anyone lifts a phone, zipped on for the trailhead and the long walk through the pines.
art: A shaggy green and rust sasquatch covers its face with one hand and walks between two pine trees and ferns, inside a round patch of forest, in green, rust, brown and cream with a worn print texture.
headline: CAMERA
inks: cream on Black and Navy, forest green on Ash
layout_story: CAMERA SHY sits below it in two huge lines of tall condensed capitals
chest: a small CAMERA over SHY wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back
warm2: cold trailheads, misty mornings and the walk back to the truck
gift_line: for the friend who hikes for the quiet and ducks every group photo.
seo_desc: A sasquatch zip up hoodie: CAMERA SHY on the back under a sasquatch hiding its face between two pines, plus stitched CAMERA SHY lettering on the chest.
